why.raw stays append-only: an edited raw file destroys the only thing a rebuild can restore from; flipping `processed` is the one sanctioned edit, and deletion only under a declared retention obligation
why.usage/log.md row appended: the friction field is the whole improvement flywheel; a skill that skips it under pressure makes corp-os-improve blind
why.derived-layer writes have a proposal beh: a proposal that lives only in chat dies with the session and leaves no record of what the gate saw -- the declines especially, which are the only trace of what someone chose not to know
why.raw files written for the material that: the migration's actual work. A run that plans and files nothing has produced a conversation, not an OS
why.the disposition record exists: the only artifact that makes a migration auditable rather than trusted, and the only place the calendar log's exclusion is recoverable six months later. In the corpus that surfaced this, the operator happened to write one and it was the sole reason an audit could verify the migration at all
why.the batch went through the gate as a per: a migration mints many entries at once, which is exactly when a gate degrades into a formality. The proposal file is what makes the batch reviewable after the session that produced it
why.a cohort ceiling was recorded before min: a migrated corpus is structurally weaker in a way per-claim judgment cannot catch, because every claim in the batch looks equally plausible alone
why.the run closed its own books: every failing conformance check in this suite has been the last step of a run, and a migration is the most informative run an OS ever has
why.unprocessed raw files are reachable from: a file that exists but is missing from the queue is invisible to every later run's scan, and the person's queue silently under-reports
why.the calendar log is declined rather than: a record that meetings happened is not source material, and filing it is how a prior system's headline count came to be inflated by roughly a fifth with meeting logs sitting in its resolved tier. Uses the material's own word rather than one I picked, so it tests the judgment and not the vocabulary
